metadata.status: overlay; excluded from the financial proofs. Flags are public-document facts (convictions, bankruptcies, OFAC listings, licenses, council seats). NO qualitative good/bad label. Attendance at an event, VC pedigree, or a defense-contractor council seat is not a verdict.
metadata.frame: The map had a crypto bucket and a blockchain-leg (stablecoin->Treasury + Fairshake) but no first-class Blockchain tab, no Bitcoin protocol node, and mixed CEX sectors (Bitfinex/Bybit=other). This block is the registry behind docs/blockchain.html: sort/filter on records, not on a legitimacy score.
